crossRefs.note: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will…
for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”
But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you…
For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.
When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand, or premeditate what you will say, but say…

translations.web: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,
translations.bsb: So make up your mind not to worry beforehand how to defend yourselves.
translations.kjv: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
translations.asv: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate beforehand how to answer:
